points.description: States one valid limitation of AJM (abrasive jet machining), e.g. low material removal rate, limited/short nozzle life (nozzle wear), high cost, or similar drawbacks consistent with the model answer.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the limitation is vague but clearly on the right track (e.g. 'slow process').

points.description: States a second, different valid limitation of AJM from the model answer (low MRR, limited nozzle life, high cost).
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the limitation is vague but clearly on the right track.

rubric.notes: Full marks for any two different limitations matching the model answer's ideas (low MRR/slow cutting, nozzle wear/short nozzle life, high cost), in any wording. Give 1 mark for one correct limitation, or part marks for vague but relevant ones. Wrong or unrelated extra remarks do not lose marks; 0 if none is valid.
